g.text: Biological question: do myeloid RNA changes reflect cell mixture, transcriptional remodeling, or sample handling?
A Verified data and biological replicates
53 libraries · 29 mice · 24 mice with paired regions
Added: RRRM-2 cerebral region · 18 different mice
RNA + ATAC measured from the same nuclei
151 corrected human targets → 143 primary mouse symbols | ISA identities · count QC · technical-library collapse
B Five biological and analytical evidence branches

g.text: RR8: six enriched populations · whole-genome count models
edgeR QL + limma/voom · GEO, article and alternative QC
All 151 targets × populations × age contrasts retained
AIM2 higher; PYCARD, IL18 and NINJ1 lower.
Non-panel reference mixtures: held-donor NNLS / ridge
New: balanced, exposure-blind PCA states (K=4 / K=6)
Mouse-state pseudobulk · cell coverage · fixed-composition checks
PYCARD persists in primary shared states.
Technical / finer-state sensitivity limits the claim.
RR3 / RR10 / RR9 context + RR23 / MHU-3 / cerebral counts
Habitat and vivarium contrasts kept separate
Nrf2 genotype interaction · 50 complete mouse-deletion fits
PYCARD corrected support varies by control / family.
Original GeoMx contrasts + RR3 donor-linked Visium
Spatial neighbours separated from exposure tests
Donor RNA and promoter ATAC · same-mission dependence
Corrected spatial / promoter flight effects unconfirmed.
Three bulk engines · complete planned testing families
Mouse deletion · HC3 intervals · exact animal permutations
50 Hallmark sets · correlation and residual-df sensitivity
Report effects, uncertainty and failed checks.
C Next mechanistic test · proposed laboratory validation
Matched handling + independently identified myeloid cells → multiplex RNA / protein → ASC, caspase and cytokine readouts → perturbation / rescue
Aim: test sensor–adaptor divergence. Computational evidence does not establish inflammasome activity or a causal protective response.
Limits carried through every branch: terminal bulk preservation; RR8 QC threshold / dissection day; RR23 collection dates; small mouse cohorts and unresolved GeoMx animal identities.
